commands: ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=reliable record:=false
timeout 3s ros2 topic echo /robot_a/sensor_pose turtlesim_msgs/msg/Pose --qos-reliability reliable --once
ros2 launch course_bringup patrol.launch.py namespace:=robot_a subscriber_reliability:=best_effort record:=true bag_dir:=evidence/pr05/bag
timeout 3s ros2 topic echo /robot_a/sensor_pose turtlesim_msgs/msg/Pose --qos-reliability best_effort --once

tests.name: qos-before: reliable echo incompatible with best_effort pub

defect.reproducer: subscriber_reliability:=reliable при pose_relay BEST_EFFORT. topic list видит /robot_a/sensor_pose, но echo --qos-reliability reliable: incompatible QoS RELIABILITY, сообщений нет (qos-before.txt).
defect.root_cause: Издатель best_effort не совместим с подписчиком reliable: DDS не доставляет сообщения при несовместимых reliability.
defect.proof_after: subscriber_reliability:=best_effort: live echo получает Pose. Bag MCAP с одним топиком. Replay с qos-overrides: best_effort echo ок, reliable снова incompatible (qos-after.txt).
